Scope and player interaction

Mounts are a later committed content system only after movement, camera, collision and animation feasibility pass. No mounted sprite, riding pose, mount creature or equipment compatibility is claimed to exist in the archive.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase21committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Unavailable → Summoning → Mounted → Dismounting → Blocked → ArtGateFailed

WBP_ActionBar observes results from URPGMountComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Mount_Prototype. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
MountDefinitionId and unlock entitlement: durable IDs
MountedMovementProfile: approved speed/collision/turn policy
MountedAppearanceSetId: body/mount/gear actions and facings, source-verified
DismountSafeTransform: server collision/navigation validated
Combat/Water/InteriorPolicy: initially dismount or reject; authored

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGMountComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_ActionBarLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RequestMount(CommandId, MountId) -> Mounted|NotUnlocked|InCombat|ArtUnavailable
RequestDismount() -> Dismounted|NoSafePosition
ValidateMountContent(MountId) -> Feasible|MissingArt|CollisionFailure

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Production first proves a developer-authored placeholder mount in the terrain lab, not on a live economy server.
  2. Server validates unlock, zone rules and current action state before changing the movement profile.
  3. Presentation selects a complete mounted set for current facing/action; do not stretch a walking person onto an invented animal.
  4. Dismount finds a valid capsule position and restores the ordinary movement profile once.
  5. Death, transfer, interiors and water use explicit dismount policy; no mount state persists as stale Actor pointers.
  6. Only after art/latency/navigation/camera tests pass may mount entitlements be enabled in catalogs.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create a feasibility-only mount definition and record all missing sprite/mesh/action requirements. Keep its production Enabled flag false.
  2. Add a test profile to L_TerrainLab with slopes, bridges, doorways and water shores.
  3. Implement movement-profile switching through the existing movement component; no parallel mount teleport integrator.
  4. Create/commission riding/mount art with common root and four/eight-facing plan, then fill appearance matrix and licenses.
  5. Reopen zone/interior/fast-travel rules and UI to show Unavailable until the gate is approved.

Reopen Phase21 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_TerrainLab / MountFeasibilityFixture. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
No mounted art -> ArtUnavailable; ordinary movement unaffected.
Dismount inside wall -> NoSafePosition or validated fallback, not clipping.
Mount speed intent forged -> server profile/correction wins.
Transfer while mounted -> documented dismount before snapshot; no duplicate body.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

No production mount speed or unlock cost selected. This gate prevents premature movement/art work from blocking Slice A/B.

Record feasibility results separately from shipped feature status. Mount action has remappable input and no mandatory rapid timing.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
